expected.finding: **[P2]** `scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py` — `candidate_anchor()` and `validity_under()` reuse evidence by topic name without checking the candidate’s keywords. After a rollback, mining can recreate `archive-branch` with different companion keywords, yet its validity is judged using the removed topic’s old trace counts. `anchor_evidence` discards the definitions needed to detect this mismatch. This can incorrectly accept or reject revisions. Preserve evidence definitions and treat counts as unknown whenever candidate keywords differ.
